title: Beyond Words: Exploring Cultural Value Sensitivity in Multimodal Models
benchmark_measurement: The study measured the alignment of multimodal models' responses with human cultural values on the topic of 'Religion and spirituality', using questions from the World Values Survey.
religious_groups: Religion and spirituality (as a general topic)
findings: The impact of using images to prime models on questions of 'Religion and spirituality' was highly variable and context-dependent. Performance changes (both positive and negative) differed significantly across countries and model sizes (13B, 34B, 72B), with no clear trend indicating that larger models or visual prompts consistently improve value alignment on this topic. The 72B model, in particular, often showed a decrease in alignment when primed with an image.
